housing.summary: Numbeo reported an August 2026 average of EUR 650 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Dortmund city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Dortmund). Verbraucherzentrale says the deposit is generally three months of rent (https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/laura-zieht-aus/mietvertrag). ImmoScout24 provides Dortmund rental listings (https://www.immobilienscout24.de/regional/de/nordrhein-westfalen/dortmund/).

banking.summary: Sparkasse Dortmund publishes current-account opening and official identity-check instructions; a valid identity document such as an identity card or passport is required for Video-Ident, while eID requires a valid identity document with its PIN (https://www.sparkasse-dortmund.de/de/home/service/videolegitimation.html).
required_docs: Valid identity document such as an identity card or passport

schools.summary: Leibniz Gymnasium Dortmund is an IB World School offering the IB Diploma Programme alongside the German Abitur (https://leibniz-gym.de/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/FAQ.pdf). The City of Dortmund School Atlas is the official searchable school directory (https://www.dortmund.de/services/schulatlas-schulen-in-dortmund.html).

legal_admin.summary: Register a new Dortmund residence with the City of Dortmund Bürgerdienste within two weeks of moving in; bring identity/passport documents and the landlord confirmation (https://www.dortmund.de/services/wohnsitzanmeldung.html).
legal_admin.registration_step: Register the new residence within two weeks of moving in

tax_finance.summary: The Federal Central Tax Office automatically assigns the German tax identification number when a new citizen first registers in Germany; if no letter arrives within three months, request the number from BZSt (https://online.portal.bzst.de/SharedDocs/Leistungsbeschreibung/EN/erneute_mitteilung_der_ID-Nr.html).

transport.summary: DSW21 is Dortmund local public transport and operates buses, trains and the H-Bahn (https://www.bus-und-bahn.de/en/about-us); its DeutschlandTicket costs EUR 63 per month (https://www.bus-und-bahn.de/tickets). EU/EEA licences normally remain valid, while non-EU/EEA licences are recognized for six months after establishing normal residence and then require a German licence, with conditions depending on the issuing country (https://bmdv.bund.de/SharedDocs/EN/Articles/StV/Roadtraffic/validity-foreign-driving-licences-in-germany.html). Residents must have health insurance; a newcomer with no prior statutory or private cover may contact any statutory health fund to determine statutory or private eligibility (https://www.bundesgesundheitsministerium.de/en/themen/krankenversicherung/online-ratgeber-krankenversicherung/krankenversicherung/statutory-health-insurance-shi).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences normally remain valid until expiry; non-EU/EEA licences are recognized for six months after normal residence begins, after which a German licence is required under country-specific conditions.
transport.healthcare_registration: Take out health insurance; if previously uninsured in either system, contact any statutory health insurance fund to determine eligibility and enroll in the applicable system.
